title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. We would like to ask a Shari Ruling regarding rent for a Madrasah which is based at an Islamic Secondary school building, the Islamic Secondary school building was opened by the current Chairman and the current Vice Chairman (a committee was later made on the bases that they would be supportive). Currently the Madrasah uses three classes in the evening for Madrasah. The Madrasah currently pay?s rent. But the issue has arisen about rent for the Madrasah when it first opened in 2004. Before the Madrasah opened, eminent scholars gave Mushwerah that the building was not used in the evenings and it would be suitable for evening Madrasah, through this it was then decided by the Chairman that the building can be used without any rent being paid, this was due to the Madrasah being new and to get the Madrasah running, at this time none of the Governors of the school were active in the daily issues of the school. From 2006 due to some issues (regarding the Islamic Secondary school) the Governors of the school got involved and they raised the issue of rent and they decided that rent should be back dated to (2004) and paid to the date of when payment first started (which was 2006). According to Shariah is it compulsory to for the Madrasah to pay the backdated rent? 1763 views Q. Assalam alaikum,There is a old masjid in our locality due to weak structure and shortage of space the masjd comette decided to dismentle the old masjid and to construct it newly,so the first part has already been dismentle and new construction is going on.In the old masjid the toilet and wazukhana was outside the masjid plinth area which is still going on,now the masjid comette wants to build the toilet and wazukhana inside the masjid varanda where namaz in jamat is still going on.now please tell me can toilet and wazukhana be made in the masjid varanda where namaz-in-jamat has been performed for last 40years and still going on. 1618 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 37814 Country: India Title: Is it possible to use the interest money to make latrines and toilets of the masjids Question: Is it possible to use the interest money to make latrines and toilets of the masjids? If not, then what will the masjid committee do with the money because a Muslim person has donated his interest money to the masjid for preparing latrines. Reply as quickly as possible because the committee wants to take quick action. Answer ID: 37814 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 533/450/B=1433) Interest money is haram and malicious. It should be given to very poor and needy person without the intention of reward. It is not lawful to use it in the construction of toilet and latrine of the mosque. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
